title: 第一卷 第26章 秘境核心，天骄云集
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
越靠近秘境核心幽谷，天地灵气愈发厚重。

    空气中的灵雾几乎凝成水雾，吸入肺腑，温润绵长。

    比起外域区域，灵气浓郁足足翻倍不止。

    寻常弟子在此修行一日，抵得上外界苦修三五日。

    但与此对应的，是无处不在的凶险。

    沿途地面遍布干涸血迹、断裂枝木，还有不少被遗弃的破损法器。

    显然，越往深处，厮杀争夺越是频繁惨烈。

    苏玄尘步履平稳，穿行在灵雾林间。

    他始终将气息压在炼气三层初阶，半点不外露锋芒。

    极品天灵根的优势，被他彻底藏入体内。

    外人观感里，他依旧是那个修为普通、年岁老朽、靠着天赋撑场面的百岁新人。

    这正是他想要的效果。

    木秀于林，风必摧之。

    他寿元微薄、根基尚浅，眼下最忌讳的便是高调张扬、被群起针对。

    一路前行，陆续遇见不少深入腹地的顶尖弟子。

    清一色炼气七层以上修为，气息强盛，身法迅捷。

    每一人，都是外门当中苦修多年的佼佼者。

    他们三三两两结队，神色警惕，目光锐利，飞速搜寻核心机缘。

    众人路过苏玄尘身侧时，大多会顿足打量两眼。

    眼底有好奇，有诧异，也有淡淡的轻视。
content_en:
The closer you get to the deep valley at the core of the secret realm, the thicker the aura of heaven and earth becomes.

    The spiritual mist in the air almost condenses into water mist, which is warm and moist when inhaled into the lungs.

    Compared to the Outer Domain area, the aura is more than twice as rich.

    An ordinary disciple practicing here for one day is worth three to five days of hard training in the outside world.

    But corresponding to this, there is danger everywhere.

    Along the way, the ground was covered with dried bloodstains, broken branches and trees, and many abandoned and damaged magical instruments.

    Obviously, the deeper you go, the more frequent and fierce fighting becomes.

    Su Xuanchen walked steadily through the spirit mist forest.

    He always kept his breath at the beginning of the third level of Qi Refining without revealing any edge.

    The advantages of the top-grade Tianlinggen were completely hidden within his body.

    In the eyes of outsiders, he is still the hundred-year-old newcomer with ordinary cultivation, old age, and relying on talent to support the scene.

    This was exactly the effect he wanted.

    Even if the trees are beautiful in the forest, the wind will destroy them.

    His longevity is meager and his foundation is still shallow. The most taboo thing at the moment is to make a high-profile statement and be targeted by groups.

    Along the way, I met many top disciples who went deep into the hinterland.

    Qingyi Qi Refining has reached the seventh level or above, with strong aura and swift movement.

    Everyone is an outstanding person among the outer sect who has practiced hard for many years.

    They formed groups in twos and threes, with alert expressions and sharp eyes, searching for core opportunities quickly.

    When people passed by Su Xuanchen, most of them would pause and take a look.

    There was curiosity, surprise, and a touch of contempt in his eyes.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 26 At the core of the secret realm, geniuses gather
